run_tosser_simulation: run the tosser simulation that tosses a capsule into a container using MuJoCo physics
load_model_from_path: load a MuJoCo XML model file from a given path using load_model_from_path
create_MjSim: create a MuJoCo physics simulator instance from a loaded model using MjSim
create_MjViewer: create a MuJoCo viewer instance to render the simulation using MjViewer
step_simulation_with_control: step the simulation forward with control inputs and render each frame using sim.step and viewer.render
